summary: Solo hiker from Austin, Texas, fell nearly 100 feet into a gully on Maroon Peak and could not self-rescue; airlifted by Flight for Life and a HAATS Blackhawk with Mountain Rescue Aspen
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Flight for Life; HAATS
